page: Microsoft Azure E96ads_v5 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the EADSv5 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 96 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 48 physical cores of an AMD EPYC 7763 processor, operating at a speed of 3.7 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The server is equipped with 672.0 GB of RAM, providing 7.0 GB of memory per core, and includes 3686 GB of local storage with Premium Storage capabilities.

Benchmark results indicate top-tier multi-core CPU performance, with stress-ng multi-core tests placing it in the top 10% of evaluated servers. PassMark CPU encryption and memory scores also rank in the top 10%. Single-core performance is strong, placing in the top 25% for stress-ng single-core tests, while Geekbench single-core and text processing scores remain in the average tier. Large-block memory bandwidth read and write speeds are average, though small-block cached read bandwidth is strong.

This hardware profile is highly suited for memory-intensive workloads, large-scale database operations, and multi-threaded decompression tasks, as evidenced by its strong PassMark database and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression scores. The inclusion of 3686 GB of local storage alongside 672.0 GB of RAM offers high resource density for data-heavy applications. It provides a cost-efficient alternative for enterprise workloads requiring substantial memory and local storage capacity without the added expense of dedicated GPU hardware.
description: Microsoft Azure E96ads_v5 is a memory-optimized virtual machine from the EADSv5 family, powered by an AMD EPYC 7763 processor. It features 96 dedicated vCPUs across 48 physical cores running at 3.7 GHz, paired with 672.0 GB of RAM and 3686 GB of local storage. Operating on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor, this x86_64 server delivers top-tier multi-core CPU performance and memory scores, ranking in the top 10% on stress-ng multi-core and PassMark encryption benchmarks. Single-core performance and large-block memory bandwidth remain in the average to strong tiers. With its high memory-to-core ratio and substantial local storage, the E96ads_v5 is highly efficient for memory-intensive enterprise applications, relational databases, and multi-threaded data processing tasks that do not require GPU acceleration.
